Corollary
[surface Ricci-flow integrated Harnack estimate] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 2.5.3\group Cao–Zhu Li-Yau-Hamilton Estimates Let $g_{ij}(x,t)$ be a complete solution of the Ricci flow on a surface with bounded and nonnegative scalar curvature. Then for any points $x_{1},x_{2}\in M$, and $0<t_{1}<t_{2}$, we have \[ R(x_2,t_2) \geq \frac{t_1}{t_2}e^{-d_{t_1}{(x_1,x_2)}^2/{4(t_2-t_1)}}R(x_1,t_1). \]

Proof

↗ thm:cz-surface-ricci-flow-differential-harnack-estimate \sketch Integrate the differential Harnack inequality along a minimizing $g(t_1)$-geodesic joining $x_1$ to $x_2$.

□
